regions.finding: Verified the true article title and aggregate CuBr2/Grignard/ammonium-salt method claim. The paper advertises online SI, but workspace association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 1 introduction and discussion of Scheme 1
regions.finding: Five named approaches (Zhang, Davies, Sawamura, the authors' 2015 work, and List) are prior literature. They are classified as five generic literature examples, not experiments of this paper.
A current-paper 0.5 mmol neutral propargylic amine/1.6 equiv EtMgBr trial in THF at 60 °C for 5 h is explicitly reported as no reaction and retained as a failed experiment.

The text distinguishes cited prior organometallic reactions of propargylic ammonium salts from this paper's generic ammonium-salt strategy; the actual drawings occur on page 2 and are not treated as row-level experiments.
The prose maps to the four Table 1 and five Table 2 rows on page 2. It additionally states that Table 2 entry 5 forms no 3b; no duplicate prose-only experiment was created.

unresolved: The Eq. 1 atmosphere, solvent volume, recovery, and detection limit are not reported.
Prior-work schemes remain generic R-group structures.

regions.finding: Original image confirms five separately attributed prior-work arrows converging on tetrasubstituted allenes. These are literature examples with generic structures and no current-paper yields.
Scheme 2a is previous work with competing allene/alkyne outcomes; Scheme 2b is this paper's general strategy. Neither is assigned a table-row yield.

Four distinct 1a/EtMgBr optimization runs were retained with 0.5 mmol 1a, row-specific 1.8/1.6/1.4/1.6 equivalents, no copper or 10 mol% CuI, THF 2.5 mL, 60 °C/5 h, and nitromethane-based 1H-NMR yields 73/72/47/86%.

Five distinct 1b optimization rows were retained with product-specific 2b and 3b NMR outcomes. Entry 4 also retains 86% isolated 2b and is merged with identical Table 3 entry 2; entry 5 preserves the table dash plus the prose statement that 3b was not formed.

Eight ammonium-salt scope rows were inspected. Entry 2 is the same 1b/CuBr2 15 mol%/1 mmol/86% isolated experiment as Table 2 entry 4 and is merged; the other seven remain independent. Footnotes for CuI, 15 mol% CuBr2, and 0.5 mmol scale are structured.
The stated optimal CuBr2 20 mol%/Grignard 1.6 equiv/THF/60 °C/argon conditions are applied to scope rows subject to explicit footnote overrides.

unresolved: Table 2 1 mmol footnote rows do not explicitly restate all scaled absolute reagent/solvent charges.
Table 3 entry 3 prints 0.5 mmol scale alongside shared 1.6 mmol EtMgBr and 1.6 equivalents; no arithmetic correction was inferred.

regions.finding: Eight distinct Grignard-scope rows were retained with shared 1h/Grignard/CuBr2/THF/60 °C/5 h conditions, isolated yields, the 15 mol% CuBr2 override, the 0.5 mmol scale footnote, and benzylmagnesium chloride substitution.
Two distinct 1 mmol experiments were retained: 1i/PhMgBr without copper gives 2q in 85%, and 1a/i-BuMgBr with 10 mol% CuI gives 2r in 94%, both at 60 °C for 5 h in THF.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Equation 4 and right-column detailed gram-scale procedure
regions.finding: Equation 4 and the detailed paragraph are one gram-scale 2b experiment. Exact CuBr2/EtMgBr/THF/workup/purification/product charges and ordered 60 °C hold, cooling, 0 °C quench, extraction and chromatography are structured. The drawing says 5 mmol 1b while the paragraph says 2.7825 g/7 mmol; both are retained as a source conflict.
CuX2/RMgX transmetalation to proposed species A followed by SN2'-type substitution is a mechanism record; A is not an isolated preparation.

Wanli Zhang is thanked for reproducing Table 3 entry 4 and Table 4 entry 6. No independent conditions, charges, yields, or run identifiers are given, so these are provenance notes and create no duplicate experiments.
Bibliography only; cited external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: Equation 4 has an unresolved 5 mmol drawing versus 7 mmol paragraph conflict.
Several displayed equations omit THF volume, workup, purification, mass, or yield basis.
Table 4 entry 6 has a 0.5 mmol/shared-1.6 mmol/1.6-equivalent inconsistency if treated as a single exact charge set.
